business_summary.text: EaseMyTrip is a leading online travel platform in India offering flights, hotels, holiday packages, rail, bus, cab, charter, visa assistance, and ancillary services. It operates globally with a focus on the Middle East and has expanded into new verticals like electric buses through its subsidiaries.
